title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct Chico State study environments, from silent library floors and reservable rooms to course-specific success centers.

cards.title: Settle into The Grove for silent study
cards.subtitle: First floor, Meriam Library
cards.notes: Choose this first-floor room for individual work; bring headphones and use the comfortable seating, Wi-Fi, or four available PCs.
cards.short_summary: A student-designed silent-study area with soft seating and computer access.
cards.evidence_claim: Meriam Library identifies The Grove as a first-floor silent-study and relaxation area with comfortable seating, wireless internet and four PCs.
cards.access_notes: The Grove is intended for silent individual study, not group work; follow current Meriam Library building access and public-use policies.

cards.title: Start research in the Research Commons
cards.subtitle: First-floor west side, Meriam Library
cards.notes: Bring source-heavy assignments here and use the clearly mapped first-floor location as a base near the library’s main services.
cards.short_summary: A named first-floor library study area suited to research-centered work.
cards.evidence_claim: Meriam Library’s current floor map lists the Research Commons as a study space on the west side of the first floor.
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to current Meriam Library building access and public-use policies; the space is on the first-floor west side.

cards.title: Rehearse together in Presentation Room 252
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Meriam Library
cards.notes: Reserve this room for presentation practice, arrive within ten minutes, and ask library staff to unlock it at the booked time.
cards.short_summary: A reservable library room designed for presentation-focused group sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Meriam Library identifies Room 252 as the Library Presentation Room and requires an eligible student reservation before staff provide entry.
cards.access_notes: Current Chico State students must reserve with an eligible university email and valid ID. Bookings are 50 minutes, with two per student daily; no food or drinks.

cards.title: Work quietly on the third floor
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Meriam Library
cards.notes: Head upstairs for focused solo work, silence your phone, and choose this floor when conversation-free study matters most.
cards.short_summary: The library’s designated floor for quiet, individual concentration.
cards.evidence_claim: Meriam Library’s current floor map designates the third floor for silent study and also locates the main collection there.
cards.access_notes: This is a silent-study floor. Use it for individual work and follow current Meriam Library building access and public-use policies.

cards.entity_name: Meriam Library Small Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Book a small-group study room
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Meriam Library
cards.notes: Reserve before meeting, keep the booking confirmation handy, and arrive promptly so the room is not released after ten minutes.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for contained collaboration inside the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Meriam Library maps small-group study rooms on the third floor and requires reservations by current students with eligible email addresses and valid IDs.
cards.access_notes: Reservation required. Eligible current students may book up to two 50-minute periods daily; the reserving student must attend with a valid ID.

cards.entity_name: Meriam Library Fourth-Floor Open Study Spaces
cards.title: Spread out in fourth-floor open study
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor, Meriam Library
cards.notes: Use the open seating for flexible solo or shared work, and bring a charger to take advantage of the floor’s mapped charging station.
cards.short_summary: Flexible open study seating near tutoring and upper-floor collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Meriam Library’s current floor map lists open study spaces, math and writing tutoring, a computer lab and a mobile charging station on the fourth floor.
cards.access_notes: Open study areas are on the fourth floor and are subject to current Meriam Library building access and public-use policies.

cards.title: Study while caring for a younger family member
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor, Meriam Library
cards.notes: Set up near the juvenile collection, keep children supervised, and use the child-size furniture and interactive rug during your session.
cards.short_summary: A caregiver-oriented study area designed for adults and children to use together.
cards.evidence_claim: The fourth-floor Wildcat Family Friendly Study Space serves students, staff and faculty caring for younger family members and includes child-size furniture and an interactive rug.
cards.source_title: Wildcat Family Friendly Study Space | Meriam Library
cards.access_notes: Multiple families may share the space. Guardians must supervise children and comply with Meriam Library’s public-use policy.

cards.entity_name: BSS Student Success Center – BSS Hall 111
cards.title: Plug in at BSS Hall 111
cards.subtitle: Behavioral and Social Sciences Building, Room 111
cards.notes: Bring individual or group coursework, recharge at the provided outlets, and confirm eligibility through enrollment in a BSS course.
cards.short_summary: A course-linked study center with group seating, individual space and power outlets.
cards.evidence_claim: Chico State lists BSS Hall Room 111 as a BSS Success Center offering group and individual study space plus outlets for students enrolled in BSS courses.
cards.source_title: Student Success and Advising | College of Behavioral and Social Sciences
cards.access_notes: For students enrolled in one or more BSS courses. Current posted hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed on academic holidays.

cards.entity_name: BSS Student Success Center – Modoc Hall 223
cards.title: Use the Modoc Hall study center
cards.subtitle: Modoc Hall, Room 223
cards.notes: Choose this BSS location when Modoc is closer, then use its individual or group workspace and nearby outlets for longer assignments.
cards.short_summary: The Modoc counterpart to BSS Hall’s discipline-specific study center.
cards.evidence_claim: Chico State lists Modoc Hall Room 223 as a BSS Success Center providing individual and group study space and access to charging outlets.
cards.source_title: Student Success and Advising | College of Behavioral and Social Sciences
cards.access_notes: For students enrolled in one or more BSS courses. Current posted hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed on academic holidays.

cards.entity_name: Natural Sciences Student Success Lab and Advising
cards.title: Study and print in Science 450
cards.subtitle: Science Building, Room 450
cards.notes: Bring Natural Sciences coursework here for a dedicated study setting, and use the same visit for printing or academic-support questions.
cards.short_summary: A Natural Sciences support room combining study space, printing and advising.
cards.evidence_claim: Chico State identifies Science Building Room 450 as a dedicated Student Success Lab where Natural Sciences majors and minors may study or print.
cards.access_notes: Dedicated to students with majors or minors in Natural Sciences; consult the college for current staffed access or advising availability.
